fields.meta_title: Automotive Survey Builder for Dealers and Shops | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build an automotive survey for car sales, service visits, test drives, and shop hours, with every answer saved to a database you own.
fields.h1: Build an Automotive Survey for Car Sales and Service
fields.hero_description: Build an automotive survey that rates every step of a sale or repair visit and saves each answer to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into an Automotive Survey
fields.features_subheading: One prompt builds the survey and the table its answers land in. Another prompt changes either before the next customer sees it.
fields.feature_1:
A rating for each step of the sale

Name the steps a buyer goes through, such as the test drive, trade-in appraisal, paperwork, and delivery. Emergent drafts a 1 to 5 rating for each, and a prompt rewords any.
fields.feature_2:
Sent when the deal or repair order closes

The app reads delivered deals and closed repair orders from your dealer management system through its API, then sends each customer the survey that matches the visit.
fields.feature_3:
Repair order and VIN on every answer

Each response is a row in a database you own, tagged with the repair order number, VIN, and advisor. Filter by advisor, or compare this quarter's scores with the last one.
fields.feature_4:
Low scores emailed to the right manager

Pick the score that needs a reply, such as 1 or 2 out of 5, and who handles it. The app emails that manager the customer's name, the repair order number, and the comment.
fields.feature_5:
One question per screen on a phone

Customers answer one question per screen on a phone, in the waiting room or at home that night. Emergent puts no cap on responses, so every buyer and service visit counts.
fields.feature_6:
Your domain, and the code on GitHub

Run the survey on your own domain, included in Emergent and billed in credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and keep it with your other tools.
fields.why_title: Why Build an Automotive Survey With Emergent?
fields.why_description: Survey answers keep the repair order or VIN they came from. Put one advisor's scores beside the store average with no spreadsheet.

fields.hero_prompt: Build an automotive survey my dealership sends 3 days after each delivery, rating every step of the sale and saving answers by VIN.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an automotive survey?

plan.angle: The top 10 for automotive survey are industry studies from consultancies and one list of car survey questions. None shows a dealer or shop how to run its own survey. This page shows the working survey: one rating per step of a sale, a service survey keyed to the repair order with low scores emailed to the service manager, a follow-up for shoppers who test drove and left, and a poll that decides a shop's hours.
tab_stories: Ravenmoor Motors sends a survey 3 days after each delivery rating the test drive, trade-in appraisal, paperwork and delivery, and 27 of the 68 buyers who answered named the paperwork wait the worst step, so sales manager Merritt Vallencourt now starts the paperwork while the car is detailed.

Dunlivet Motors surveys each service customer when the repair order closes, and a score of 1 or 2 emails service manager Corentin Orloff, so when Vesna Saarinen scores repair order 58214 a 2 because the brake squeal came back, he books her a recheck the next morning.

Thornecastle Auto Group surveys shoppers who test drove and did not buy within 14 days, and 17 of the 41 who answered said the trade-in offer was too low, so sales director Leopold Lundqvist now walks every shopper through the appraisal sheet.

Copperwhistle Auto Repair asks its 590 customers which extra hours they would use, and of the 212 who answered, 131 chose Saturday mornings and 58 chose evening pickup, so owner Oriel Hastrup opens Saturdays from 8 to noon.
